title: Zesty Northern Thai Peanut Curry
description: A nutty, crunchy, crowd-pleaser northern Thai curry with passion fruit pulp, sous-vide tofu, and a poached egg, served in individual mini cocottes.
instructions: Trim the tofu into 1 cm cubes, vacuum seal them with 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp coconut milk, and 1 tsp lime zest, then sous-vide at 75°C for 30 minutes.
While the tofu cooks, blend passion fruit pulp with 1 tbsp peanut butter, a pinch of salt, and a splash of coconut milk until smooth.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and quickly sear the cooked tofu cubes until golden, about 2 minutes per side.
Transfer the seared tofu to individual mini cocottes and pour the passion fruit peanut sauce over them.
Add sliced fresh chili, minced garlic, and 2 tbsp peanut slivers to each cocotte, then cover and steam gently for 5 minutes to meld the flavors.
Slide a poached or fried egg into the center of each cocotte, letting the yolk swirl into the sauce.
Garnish with additional lime zest and a few extra peanut slivers before serving.
Serve immediately, letting guests stir the egg into the curry for a creamy finish.
